properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 15 at 2:48PM CDT until October 16 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Norman has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Oklahoma...

North Canadian River near Yukon affecting Canadian and Oklahoma
Counties.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...North Canadian River near Yukon.

* WHEN...From this evening to Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 14.0 feet, Flooding or isolation of suburban home
sites and rural areas occurs along the North Canadian River
valley... from near Banner Road to the headwaters of Lake
Overholser. The Garth Brooks Avenue crossing northwest of Yukon
floods. Low-lying rural roads are inund
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 300 AM CDT.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 2:46PM CDT until October 16 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in
Oklahoma...

North Canadian River at El Reno affecting Canadian County.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...North Canadian River at El Reno.

* WHEN...Until Friday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 15.0 feet, The river remains mostly within its banks
in Canadian County... from near El Reno to areas upstream of Yukon.
Any overbank flows affect very small agricultural areas. Low-lying
fields and private roads near the river could be briefly isolated
by flows in cutoff channels crossing the flood plain.

* ADDI
properties.instruction:
If you encounter a flooded roadway, turn around and find an
alternative route.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 300 AM CDT.

properties.areaDesc: New Buffalo MI to St Joseph MI; Michigan City IN to New Buffalo MI
properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 15 at 3:47PM EDT until October 16 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, southeast wind 10 to 15
knots becoming west, increasing to 20 to 30 knots and waves 2
feet or less building to 7 to 10 feet. For the Gale Warning,
north winds 25 to 35 knots with gusts up to 40 knots and waves
11 to 16 feet expected.

* WHERE...Michigan City IN to St Joseph MI.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 11 PM this evening
to 11 AM EDT Friday. For the Gale Warning, from 11 AM Friday
to 2 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
